page_title: VAL 3-2 ALA | Valencia v Alaves 08/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' That's it for today, Jose Guzman has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+11' Valencia quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

90+10' Jon Pacheco (Alaves) must have known he would be sent off for this foul, but he had to stop the opponent at all costs. Jose Guzman shows him a second yellow card and the game has ended for him.
90+9' 3 - 2 It's a goal! Hugo Duro (Valencia) coolly displays his experience and converts the penalty kick.
90+9' Hugo Duro (Valencia) is going to take the penalty!

90+8' Yet another yellow card and Ander Guevara (Alaves) is sent off for talking out of turn to the referee. Definitely a harebrained moment from the player. Jose Guzman doesn't allow any discussions.
90+6' Jon Pacheco (Alaves) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jose Guzman blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY to Valencia!
90+4' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
90+2' Ander Guevara (Alaves) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
90' 2 - 2 Goal! Eray Comert (Valencia) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:2.
90' Unai Nunez (Valencia) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header only flies onto the right post and away off it!
89' Valencia take a short corner kick.
89' The corner from Andre Almeida (Valencia) is hurriedly cleared. The ball is out of play. Valencia will have a chance to score from a corner.
89' Jose Gaya (Valencia) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball goes behind for a corner. Valencia will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
88' Andre Almeida (Valencia) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
87' Andre Almeida (Valencia) serves up a nice cross, but Antonio Sivera punches the ball away.
86' Mariano Diaz (Alaves) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.
84' Here comes a substitution. Mariano Diaz (Alaves) is brought on as a substitute for Toni Martinez.
82' It is time for a substitution. Diego Lopez (Valencia) is on for Largie Ramazani.
82' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Javi Guerra as he is replaced by Andre Almeida (Valencia).
82' Carlos Corberan has decided to substitute Thierry Rendall and he is replaced by Dani Raba (Valencia).
82' Referee Jose Guzman sees the trip by Antonio Blanco (Alaves) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
77' The resulting set piece from Valencia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Filip Ugrinic trots off the pitch and is replaced by Hugo Duro (Valencia).

71' 1 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Lucas Boye (Alaves) gets on the scoresheet after converting a chance from the resulting corner kick. He finds himself some space inside the box and plants a perfect header inside the right post. 1:2.
71' Denis Suarez (Alaves) will deliver the corner kick.
70' Carlos Corberan has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) replacing Luis Rioja.
69' Lucas Boye (Alaves) decides to have a go at goal from the edge of the box, but the wall jumps as one and blocks the free kick. Danger averted!
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ander Guevara (Alaves) comes onto the pitch for Carles Alena.
68' Quique Sanchez Flores prepares a substitution. Jon Guridi is replaced by Denis Suarez (Alaves).
68' Guido Rodriguez (Valencia) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle. Alaves win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
66' Lucas Boye (Alaves) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Stole Dimitrievski, who pulls off a stunning save!
65' Javi Guerra (Valencia) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
63' The resulting corner from Javi Guerra (Valencia) is cleared.

62' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception. Now Valencia have a corner.

60' Lucas Boye (Alaves) missed a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball flies well wide of the right post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
58' Jon Pacheco (Alaves) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
56' The attendance is 41512.
53' Valencia take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

53' Largie Ramazani (Valencia) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.
48' The Valencia players halt their celebrations as referee Jose Guzman makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
47' 1 - 1 Goal! Javi Guerra (Valencia) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:1.
47' Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) sends a rebound goalwards towards the left-hand post, but the goalkeeper stretches to stop it.
46' Jose Guzman blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' Yellow card. Yusi (Alaves) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
40' Carles Alena (Alaves) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
38' Lucas Boye (Alaves) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
37' Javi Guerra (Valencia) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
36' Jon Guridi (Alaves) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
35' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
34' Eray Comert (Valencia) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
33' Luis Rioja (Valencia) and Javi Guerra attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
31' A cross from Angel Perez (Alaves) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
30' Quique Sanchez Flores is forced to make a change. Carlos Protesoni is unable to continue due to injury, Yusi (Alaves) comes on.
28' Looks like Carlos Protesoni (Alaves) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
27' Valencia fail to score from a corner as Antonio Sivera (Alaves) leaps to collect the ball.
25' Luis Rioja (Valencia) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
25' Wow, what an escape. Javi Guerra (Valencia) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. It will be a corner kick for Valencia.
23' Lucas Boye (Alaves) makes a strong challenge and Jose Guzman blows for a foul.

21' Largie Ramazani (Valencia) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the bottom right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Antonio Sivera pulls off an easy save.
20' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) towers above the defence but fails to trouble the keeper, heading the corner kick well wide of the left post from close range.
20' Corner kick. Luis Rioja (Valencia) is ready to send the ball into the box.
17' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Largie Ramazani (Valencia) was quite harsh and Jose Guzman didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
15' Jonny Otto (Alaves) rips an amazing volley from deep inside the box that goes narrowly wide of the left post.
13' Luis Rioja (Valencia) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
13' A quickly taken corner by Valencia.

12' Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. Valencia force their opponents to concede a corner.
12' Luis Rioja (Valencia) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
10' Carles Alena (Alaves) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Jose Guzman stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
6' Carles Alena (Alaves) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
6' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
3' 0 - 1 Goal! Lucas Boye (Alaves) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Stole Dimitrievski into left side of the goal.
2' Lucas Boye (Alaves) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
1' Guido Rodriguez (Valencia) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. The advantage of a penalty kick is given to Alaves.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Alaves will have the kick-off.
Jose Guzman was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
